taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from Features of individual bones (Lower Limb).

words.clue: Cup-shaped socket of the hip bone that articulates with the femoral head to form the hip joint
Bony prominence of the ischium where bedsores develop in bedridden patients
Small depression on the femoral head for attachment of the ligament carrying the obturator artery
Large lateral projection of the femur serving as attachment for gluteus medius muscle
Smooth rounded projection of the femur that articulates with the tibia at the knee
Curved upper border of the ilium palpable as the hip bone and used for bone marrow biopsy
Bony landmark on the ischium that divides the greater and lesser sciatic notches
Large oval opening bounded by pubis and ischium that transmits the obturator nerve and vessels
Secondary cartilaginous joint between the two pubic bones that can widen during pregnancy
Smooth concavity on the medial surface of the ilium where the iliacus muscle originates
